data.name: Ghostbane
data.description: A hallowed necromancer can expend 3 uses of her positive touch as a swift action while casting a spell to affect undead as if the spell were prepared with the Ectoplasmic Spell (APG), Thanatopic Spell (APG), or Threnodic Spell (APG)feat.
